name: native-select
useFor: Use where the platform picker serves better than a custom list: long lists on phones, forms that must work without script. Pair it with a Field or Label and give it a name. Use Select for a styled list.
constraints: A custom arrow on top of the browser's own
source: Extrapolated from opencommerce (the input and select field)
title: Native Select
description: The browser's own select in the brand's field: 36px, 8px corners, the hairline and the drawn chevron.
